title: Base case and recursive case
hints: A recursive function needs a base case that returns without recursing, and a recursive case that calls itself on a smaller input.
Factorial(0) and Factorial(1) are both 1. Fib(0) is 0 and Fib(1) is 1; every later Fib(n) is Fib(n-1) + Fib(n-2).
if n <= 1 { return 1 }; return n * Factorial(n-1). And: if n < 2 { return n }; return Fib(n-1) + Fib(n-2).
